_meta.about: Shared test vectors for the Friends clients, section 5 of docs/FRIENDS-CLIENTS.md (decisions D5, D6, D7, D11, D13, D14, D16, D17, D18, and for F4 D26, D27, D28, D30). Every client loads this file and no row may be adjusted per platform. The rows were produced by a reference implementation of the spec and checked against a second, independent one; the link rows also agree with packages/deep-links parseDeepLink.

encoding.unit×count: lengthRule rows: the string `unit` repeated `count` times. Lengths are UTF-16 code units, as the server counts them (an emoji is 2).
encoding.sort.friends: Rows are shuffled on purpose; `expect` lists uids in display order. `lastAtMs` is lastMessage.at in epoch milliseconds (64-bit) and is absent when the card has no lastMessage. Order: cards with `lastAtMs` first, newest first; then the others; equal times and the others by displayName with the locale collation at primary strength (letters compared ignoring case and accents); then by uid compared as text (so n10 comes before n9). Names are ASCII letters only on purpose: that is where every platform collator agrees in every locale of the app. Digits, spaces, punctuation and non-Latin scripts follow each platform's own tables and are not in the vectors.
encoding.sort.cards: The whole users/{uid}/friends collection, shuffled. State decides first: incoming, outgoing, friends. Requests: newest `since` first (epoch ms), then uid. Friends: exactly as sort.friends (their `since` decides nothing).
encoding.sort.requests: Incoming before outgoing, then newest `since` (epoch ms) first, then uid.
encoding.unread: `card` uses the friend card's own field names; a missing counter is 0. expect = max(0, lastSeq - lastReadSeq). lastChangeSeq never counts.
encoding.badge: `cards` is the whole collection, each card reduced to the fields that matter. expectCount = incoming cards + the unread of the friends cards; outgoing cards add nothing. expectText is the tab-badge text: null at 0, the number up to 99, 99+ from 100.
encoding.query.expect: kind is handle | email | code | invalid. lookup is the body of the first call; confirm is the body of the call after the person confirms (request carries a requestId minted at that moment; redeem carries one too).
encoding.links.typed.expect: null for a link that is invalid or is not a Friends route.
encoding.links.push.expect: The lingxi:// link a notification tap opens, or null when the push route is not accepted.
encoding.offers.nowMs: The clock of every `offers` row, epoch milliseconds. Offers are compared with it, never with the device clock, so the rows do not age.
encoding.offers.expiry: remaining = expiresAtMs - nowMs. remaining <= 0: {state: expired} (the row shows friends_offer_expired and Dismiss; the comparison is strict, as on the server). 0 < remaining <= 24 hours: {state: live, unit: hour, value: ceil(remaining / 3600000)}, 1 to 24. More than 24 hours: {state: live, unit: day, value: ceil(remaining / 86400000)}, 2 to 7. unit and value go to the platform's relative-time formatter in the future direction ("in 3 days") and the result is the %@ of friends_offer_expires; that text is the platform's own and is not in the vectors. An offer expired for longer than offerGraceDays is still `expired` here: the server deletes it on its next daily prune and the listener then removes the row.
encoding.offers.sort: Rows are shuffled on purpose; `expect` lists teamIds in display order. Live offers (expiresAtMs > nowMs) before expired ones; within each group the larger expiresAtMs first (the newest offer, because an offer lives a fixed time); then teamId compared as text by code unit (so team_10 comes before team_9).
encoding.offers.badge: Like `badge`, plus `offers`, the expiresAtMs of every offer the person holds. expectCount = the count of `badge` for `cards` + the number of offers with expiresAtMs > nowMs. Expired offers and outgoing requests add nothing. expectText is the tab-badge text as in `badge`.
encoding.offers.picker: The Invite friends list of D26. `cards` is the whole users/{uid}/friends collection (reduced, shuffled; names are ASCII letters as in sort.friends); a case may carry its own `cards`. `members` are the uids already in the team (the person included), `query` is the filter text. expect = the uids to list, in order: the cards whose state is friends and whose uid is not in members, in the Friends order of sort.friends, then only those matching `query` by the rule of the `filter` section (an empty query matches all).
encoding.offers.entry: Whether the team details offer Invite friends (D26): only to an owner or an admin, whatever the member count (a full team still shows it; the server answers MEMBER_LIMIT).
encoding.offers.errors: The string key for an error code of offerTeam, acceptOffer or declineOffer (D30). The key is the action's own row when it has one, else the common row (session, network, invalid input, rate limit), else friends_error_generic. These actions never use `errors`: its MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED and STALE_MEMBERSHIP rows mean "the chat ended" and would be wrong here. definitive is false only for SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, as in `errors`.

unread.note: no counters yet: no message was ever sent
messages and no read mark: all unread
a read mark ahead of lastSeq never goes negative
a read mark and no messages
edits and recalls move lastChangeSeq, not lastSeq

badge.note: a read mark ahead of lastSeq counts as zero

query.note: dot is not a handle character
dash is not a handle character
non-ASCII is not a handle character
31 characters is neither code nor handle
a team invitation is not a friend link

expiry.note: an hour after it was sent: 6 days 23 hours left still reads 7 days
2 days and 1 hour left rounds up to 3 days
1 day and 1 ms left is 2 days
exactly 24 hours left switches to hours
23 hours 30 minutes left rounds up to 24 hours
90 minutes left rounds up to 2 hours
expires exactly now: expired (strict comparison, as on the server)
expired 3 days ago: still listed, dismissable
expired 7 days and 1 ms ago: past the server grace, still shown as expired until the prune deletes it

badge.note: an offer that expires exactly now adds nothing
outgoing requests add nothing, a live offer does
adds up with requests and unread: 2 + (3 + 0 + 1) + 3 live; the expired one adds nothing

cases.note: a team of one: every friend in the Friends order (newest message first, then by name, then uid); requests are not listed
a member who is not a friend changes nothing
everyone is already in the team: empty (friends_invite_empty)
the filter matches a name or a handle
a member is not listed even when the filter matches
a request is never listed even when the filter matches
an outgoing request is never listed either
